data.title: 中野三玖 · 泳池畔低头用吸管喝抹茶汽水的羞涩侧影
data.action: 曲腿坐在泳池边铺着的淡蓝色浴巾上，双手护住高腰泳裤边沿，侧头低低含着抹茶冷饮吸管，眼神悄悄上瞄
data.location: 热带度假酒店家庭式私人内庭泳池畔
data.lighting: 树影斑驳的午后阳光照在水蓝色的泳池与瓷砖上，柔和漫射光为少女白皙的香肩与脸颊镀上柔粉色
data.camera: medium shot, slightly low angle intimate framing, soft natural lighting, bashful romantic mood
data.mood: 羞涩内敛、纯情守护与悄然萌动的少女情愫
data.description: 蝉鸣在庭院棕榈树间拉长声调。三玖小心翼翼地把脖颈上的防水耳机往上推了推，高腰泳装适度地包裹着姣好的少女身线。她小口吸着抹茶汽水，额前的刘海稍稍遮住一只眼，悄悄用余光打量着身侧走近的身影，声音轻若蚊蚋——「那个……这个颜色，会不会看起来太保守了？但是二乃说……很适合我。你……觉得好看吗？」
data.promptProse: Nakano Miku sits bashfully on a poolside towel in her retro matcha-blue high-waisted bikini with teal headphones around her neck, sipping matcha soda through a straw while glancing up shyly through her bangs. Warm afternoon sunlight glints across the calm resort pool, casting gentle dancing caustic reflections across her modest high-waisted swimsuit.
data.animaCaption: Soft afternoon poolside ripples bathe her modest, lovely silhouette as she gathers courage for your praise. Warm afternoon sunlight glints across the calm resort pool, casting gentle dancing caustic reflections across her modest high-waisted swimsuit.
